title: Rabbi Yaakov Dromaya or Dromena
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He was still privileged to sit before Rabbi Elazar, as in Sukkah ch. 4 halakha 2, where he asked: "Our mishnah is not in accordance with Rabbi Dosa" — Rabbi Elazar said there, etc.

He was a leading student of Rabbi Assi and questioned him in Jerusalem Talmud Terumot, chapter 3, end of halakhah 1; Maaser Sheni 1:1, 2b, and 3:5; Yevamot 1:1, 3a, 1:6 and 2:4; Nazir 8:1; and Horayot 3:2. Although the last passage reads Rabbi Yose, Rabbi Assi is sometimes called Rabbi Yose.
And in Berakhot ch. 1 halakha 1, Rabbi Yaakov Dromena said in the name of Rabbi Yehuda ben Pazi. And he is mentioned at the beginning of Taanit ch. 2: he said, why do they blow with horns?

notes.text: The Yevamot suffix 3a and Maaser Sheni suffix 2b are folios, not additional halakhot. The checked Terumot calls the teacher Yose; Hyman’s Assi/Yose equivalence remains his claim.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 3:1 has Yaakov Dromaya questioning Rabbi Yose. Hyman’s identification of this Yose with Assi remains his; the witness does not authorize merging the names. The supplied 2b and 3a suffixes remain folio references rather than added halakhot, and Dromaya/Dromena forms are retained.
